subject: Re: EBP status: completion demo done, RNN sampler instability on point clouds
body:
Katya, Alina,

Decision for the June 25 LRB slot: scope is point-cloud denoising only. Generation via the RNN sampler moves to Q3 - Katya's ablations improved things (four of five seeds now converge) but "four of five" is not a launch sentence. The 30% Chamfer reduction on partner scans is, so that's our headline.

We're also cutting the VIP baseline comparison from the deck; GP and Neural Process baselines are enough to make the multi-modality point and nobody at the board will ask for a third.

Nadia - adding you so the pre-read lands in the right pipeline; doc coming by Friday.

Alina, one ask: hold the team shape steady through July 6 so we finish the window clean, then we rebalance for the Q3 generation push per your budget plan.

Lucia
